title: Marathon
claims: The marathon is a road running event.
The standard marathon distance is 42.195 kilometres.

claimVerification.note: 原文：“The event takes place on the road and the finishing order of the race is determined by time.”
原文：“a distance of 26 miles and 385 yards (42.195km)”，并写明 1921 年标准化。
